description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for managing 'My Claim Requests' in the OrangeHRM system, including creating, retrieving, and listing claim requests with validation and filtering.

classes.name: MyClaimRequestAPI
classes.description: API class for handling 'My Claim Requests' operations such as create, retrieve, list, with validation and filtering.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new claim request, delegating to parent implementation.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks if the request is made by the employee themselves; always returns true in this implementation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a claim request.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific claim request, delegating to parent implementation.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Gets the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a specific claim request.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all claim requests for the authenticated user, delegating to parent implementation.

methods.name: getClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Creates a new filter parameters object for searching claim requests.

methods.name: getEndPointCollectionResult
methods.description: Returns a collection result object, choosing model based on the 'model' parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter to the logged-in user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing claim requests, including sorting and pagination.
